comments.text:
The claim gets rejected because of the following
1. If there is a non disclosure  of any PED found at the time of claim, then it can be rejected.
2. Something which is permanently excluded in the policy - you can refer the list of permanent exclusions here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eYI9df3r_8s
3. Anything which is in waiting period for specific exclusions for 2 years, which is not applicable in your case
